name: STAR
recent: Star Media 2026年第三季度亏损扩大至约1200万令吉，广告需求疲软导致营收下滑。前三季度营收同比增长23%至1.951亿令吉。公司于9月10日发布了一项未指明类别的公告。
notable: 2026年第三季度亏损扩大至约1200万令吉，因广告需求疲软。
2026年前三季度营收同比增长23%至1.951亿令吉。
risks: 2026年第三季度亏损较上年同期扩大。
广告需求疲软对营收造成压力。
earnings: 2026年3月31日止季度营收为3941.4万令吉，环比下降20.2%，同比下降33.7%；净亏损850.8万令吉，净利率为-21.6%，上年同期为-1.5%。

recent_en: Star Media's 3Q2026 loss widened to about RM12 million as advertising demand weakened. 9M2026 revenue rose 23% year-on-year to RM195.1 million. The company issued an unspecified announcement on 10 September.
notable_en: 3Q2026 loss widened to about RM12 million due to weaker advertising demand.
9M2026 revenue rose 23% year-on-year to RM195.1 million.
risks_en: 3Q2026 loss widened compared to the prior year.
Weaker advertising demand weighed on revenue.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 March 2026, revenue was RM39.414 million, down 20.2% QoQ and 33.7% YoY; net loss was RM8.508 million with a net margin of -21.6% versus -1.5% a year earlier.
